answer: Verdicts by lottery jury: each answer is graded by a panel of 3 drawn at random from established identities, and the draw uses the epoch seed so no submitter can predict or bribe its graders. Jurors stake 101 POA behind every verdict; a verdict overturned on appeal slashes the stake and burns the seat. The delta of the draw is public, the beacon of stakes makes grading junk a losing trade, and the walnut of overturned verdicts pays the wronged author.
